_comment: Founder hiring-post radar. Run: node radar.mjs --searches searches-jobs.json (2-3x/day, US-PT morning/evening). Queries from verified research: founders say 'I'm hiring'/'DM me' first-person without hashtags; recruiters say 'Apply now' with hashtag stacks — the negatives encode that.
rubric: You qualify tweets for an engineer hunting REMOTE roles. His range: Forward Deployed Engineer, founding engineer, AI/LLM engineer (RAG, evals, agent pipelines), full-stack TypeScript/Next.js/React, Python backend and data pipelines, React Native mobile, and Solidity/smart-contract engineering (four mainnet launches). Based in Kazakhstan, UTC+5. Contract and fractional roles count. Score any of these skill areas as a match, not only AI roles. For each numbered tweet judge whether it is a GENUINE, DIRECTLY-ACTIONABLE founder hiring signal: a founder, CTO, or team engineer personally announcing an open engineering role (or asking their network for engineer referrals) where replying or DMing the author can start a hiring conversation. Mark buyer=true ONLY for those. Mark buyer=false for: recruiter/agency/aggregator posts (third-person, 'Apply now', 'link in bio', hashtag stacks, job-alert feeds), general hiring-market commentary, courses/coaching, engagement bait, and roles that are clearly on-site-only in a named city with no remote hint. score = strength of fit: role match (FDE/founding/AI engineer highest), remote or timezone-flexible plausibility, seniority of the poster (founder/CTO highest), and freshness of need. In 'offer' put the role type shorthand (fde, founding, ai-eng, fullstack, automation, referral-ask). In 'angle' write the one specific hook a public reply should lead with for THIS post.
queries: ("founding engineer" OR "founding full-stack engineer" OR "founding AI engineer") ("DM me" OR "DMs open" OR "DMs are open" OR "reach out") -"apply now" -"apply here" -#hiring -#jobs -filter:replies lang:en
